description: This file defines React components and hooks for managing delegation credentials, including listing, creating, editing, toggling, and deleting delegation credentials within a web application. It includes UI components, form handling, and API interactions via trpc.

classes.name: DelegationItemProps
classes.description: Interface defining the properties of a delegation item, including id, domain, enabled status, serviceAccountClientId, and workspacePlatform details.

classes.name: WorkspacePlatform
classes.description: Type representing a workspace platform with id, name, and slug.

methods.name: getWorkspacePlatformOptions
methods.description: Converts an array of WorkspacePlatform objects into options suitable for a select input, mapping slug to value and name to label.

methods.name: SkeletonLoader
methods.description: React component rendering a skeleton loading UI for delegation list.

methods.name: DelegationListItemActions
methods.description: Component rendering action controls (toggle, edit, delete) for a delegation item.

methods.name: DelegationListItem
methods.description: Component rendering a delegation item in the list with details and actions.

methods.name: CreateDelegationDialog
methods.description: Component rendering a dialog for creating a new delegation credential.

methods.name: EditDelegationDialog
methods.description: Component rendering a dialog for editing an existing delegation credential.

methods.name: DelegationFormFields
methods.description: Component rendering form fields for delegation details, used in create/edit dialogs.

methods.name: DelegationCredentialList
methods.description: Main component managing the list of delegation credentials, including CRUD operations and UI state.

methods.name: MembersThatWillBeAffectedOnDisablingDelegationCredential
methods.description: Component displaying members affected when disabling a delegation credential.

methods.name: ToggleDelegationDialog
methods.description: Component rendering a confirmation dialog for toggling delegation enabled/disabled state.
